items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: when I came out of the army I got the 52nd Street jazz, with Kenny Clark, Fats Navarro, Sonny Stitt.

ctx.x: I know he said he tried to get you on every session he ever did.

That is right. I -- when I came out of the army I got the 52nd Street jazz, with Kenny Clark, Fats Navarro, Sonny Stitt. I've got solos, I've had people to send me solos, send me a recording of -- I mean, to send me the recording. Maybe because they liked the solo I played so well. How can they do this to me?

They're amazed made in Washington too because they tried to do some research on you too, and to send me material, and they couldn't find anything either. They only thing they could find was the Chilton book -- (inaudible)
